verdict.rationale: Privacy posture, including opting out of telemetry or usage tracking, is a fair question for a hosted media relay service, but the evidence pack never mentions telemetry, analytics, or any opt-out control. Relay isolation, scoped tokens, and unstored token secrets are adjacent security features, not a telemetry opt-out.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
